source_evidence: Direct stock plans usually will not allow you to buy or sell shares at a specific market price or at a specific time.
question: Misconception: Direct stock plans let investors choose exactly when to trade and the exact market price.
answer: Direct stock plans usually do not offer that level of timing or price control. The company may buy or sell shares for the plan at set times and at an average market price. Also, while these plans may save on commissions, other fees may apply.
